blocks.text: A briefing on the current-state review, prepared for Joseph Wallace and the finance leadership by the Calderwood engagement team.

items: The engagement began on {{fact:f:E-2009-003.start}} and is planned to run for about four months.
We are in the opening phase, understanding how each of the two combined businesses runs today.
Nothing is settled yet; today's purpose is to share what the review has surfaced and to agree the questions worth pursuing.
Jason Torres, Principal, owns the relationship and is your point of contact for any decision of substance.
Daniel Leach leads the current-state mapping and the combined cost baseline.
Mary Parker leads the market and peer research that frames where the value lies.

blocks.text: What the review shows so far

items: The two operating models overlap most in the shared support functions, which is where early consolidation is most likely to be considered.
The combined cost baseline is largely assembled; a small number of finance schedules are still being reconciled with your team.
Customer-facing operations differ more than either side expected, and will need care so that integration does not disturb what is working.
Which functions to combine first, and the sequence in which the organization can absorb the change.
Where the near-term savings are real, as against where they only appear on paper.
How to protect the parts of each business that are already performing while the integration proceeds.
Close out the remaining finance schedules with Joseph Wallace's team this week.
Hold the working session to review these findings in full.
Agree the two or three decisions the integration turns on, so the next phase can begin with a clear mandate.
